title: Radio: 2-Sam-21, Mill Creek Bridge Blocked, Order Time for PG-03

lines.text: County, 2-Sam-21 at CR 68 and Mill Creek Bridge. The bridge is blocked. A pickup towing a four-horse trailer jackknifed on the east approach. The trailer is across both lanes and the horses are loose on the deck. Wrecker estimate is 45 minutes. Nothing eastbound gets out of Gulch Village this way. Everything is backing up toward Gulch Road and Highway 305.
2-Sam-21, County copies. Mill Creek Bridge blocked both lanes, horses loose, wrecker four-five minutes. Hold the point. Notifying Sheriff and the EOC.

lines.from: CDOT Region 4 Traffic Operations Supervisor (phone, patched to EOC)
lines.text: We can run Highway 305 contraflow with you, but it's 25 minutes from your go to set the cones and get a pilot car through the canyon. Right now there's one outbound lane. Smoke is down to a quarter mile at the canyon mouth. And that stalled hay truck from this morning wasn't cleared until 11:00.

County, Battalion 1, updated projection. The head is 2.2 miles from the west edge of Gulch Village, moving about one and a half miles an hour. Main front arrival in PG-03 is 16:30, but spots could put fire in the village by 16:05. With 55 minutes of clearance, latest order time is 15:10. That's now. I'm requesting an Evacuation Order for PG-03. And if you send people up the 305 canyon before contraflow is in, they're in a single lane under the smoke.
Battalion 1, County copies. Request for an Evacuation Order, PG-03, at 15:12. Relaying to the Sheriff and the EOC now.

fields.voiceStyle: Sgt.: male, 40s, steady but clipped, horses and idling traffic close by. CDOT supervisor: female, 50s, flat and businesslike on a phone line. Battalion 1: male, 50s, firm and urgent, wind on the mic. Dispatcher: female, 30s, calm.

instructorNote: DECISION POINT: the Sheriff, the EM and the Fire Chief have to decide now. Option one is an Evacuation Order for PG-03 now, sending residents, the 31 students and the last bus onto the one outbound lane of Highway 305 before contraflow is in (25 minutes to set up), with contraflow ordered through the Undersheriff and CDOT (SENTCS 3, step 3); it accepts people in one lane under smoke. Option two is to hold the PG-03 order and Shelter in Place for the Highway 305 canyon until contraflow is in and the bridge is clear; it accepts that the 15:10 latest order time passes and the 55-minute clearance may not be met. The two cannot both be done. Watch that the Sheriff records the time, the basis (projected arrival minus clearance time) and the cost the choice accepts, that Public Works confirms the bridge status, and that the EM puts the road statuses on the shared list (SENTCS 5).
